notes.title: MadGate Community Playtest is Live and we want your feedback!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that we have launched the official Deck Forge Discord server!

https://discord.gg/Uw9eWVyaZH

You will be able to connect with other members of our community, find people to play against, chat with developers, participate in exclusive events, and stay up to date with the latest Deck Forge news and updates. We welcome your feedback and ideas for improving the MadGate card game.
